query: what indexing strategy does the search layer use

seed_memories.content: The search layer indexes documents in Tantivy and scores them with BM25 over tokenized fields.
Vector recall uses an HNSW graph for approximate nearest neighbor lookup over embeddings.
Reciprocal rank fusion merges the BM25 and vector result lists into a single ranking.
Knowledge graph signals expand the candidate set by following concept links during recall.
